=== DESIGN DIRECTION (strictly follow) ===
Cinematic museum-night aesthetic: luxury museum after dark, velvet darkness, golden spotlights, quiet mystery, art-house cinema, premium cultural event.

- Headlines: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
- Body: Inter, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

- <title>ARTIFACT: Museum Night — 18 October 2026 · The Old Gallery, Warsaw</title>
- meta description about the after-hours event
- Open Graph: og:title, og:description, og:image = https://source.unsplash.com/featured/2400x1400?museum,night
- inline SVG favicon via data URI (simple gold "A" monogram or gold diamond shape on dark background, URL-encoded)

- Logo: ARTIFACT (serif, letter-spaced, with small gold diamond/dot accent)
- Links: Program, Artists, Venue, Tickets, FAQ (anchor links with smooth scroll; active state auto-updates while scrolling via IntersectionObserver or scroll handler — active link gets gold color + underline)
- CTA button "Get Tickets" (gold)
- Hamburger menu on mobile (≤820px) that toggles a dropdown panel; hamburger animates to X; aria-expanded attribute managed; menu closes on link click

2) HERO (full viewport cinematic):
- Background image: https://source.unsplash.com/featured/2400x1400?museum,night (cover, with onerror fallback to a CSS gradient so page still looks good offline)
- Dark overlay + spotlight gradient (radial gold glow, vignette)
- Eyebrow/event name: "ARTIFACT: Museum Night"
- Large serif headline: "Museum Night, Reimagined"
- Metadata: 18 October 2026 · 19:00–02:00 · The Old Gallery, Warsaw (as small metadata badges/chips with icons — at least 3 badges)
- CTAs: "Get Tickets" (scrolls to tickets) and "Save to Calendar" (generates .ics, see special feature)
- Subtle scroll-down indicator
- Entrance animations on load (CSS keyframes fade/slide up staggered)

3) CONCEPT / INTRO:
- Short editorial paragraph (2-3 sentences, elegant) about the event
- 3 glass feature cards: "After-hours exhibitions", "Live performances", "Guided hidden-room tours" — each with a small inline SVG icon (gold stroke), title, short description; hover lifts card + gold border glow
- Thin gold divider above section

- 19:00 — Doors Open (Welcome & coat check, Main Entrance)
- 19:30 — Curator Welcome (Opening address, Grand Hall)
- 20:00 — Hidden Collection Tour (Guided tour, Vault Wing)
- 21:00 — Live Ambient Performance (Live score, Sculpture Court)

- 23:00 — Artist Talk (Conversation, Auditorium)
- 00:00 — Midnight Gallery Walk (Dimmed-lit walk, Permanent Galleries)
- 01:00 — Closing Sound Session (Ambient set, Rotunda)
Alternate items left/right on desktop, stacked on mobile. Reveal on scroll.

5) ARTISTS / SPEAKERS — exactly 8 cards in an asymmetric/staggered grid (varying card offsets via nth-child margin-top on desktop):
Each card: image (object-fit cover, fixed aspect ratio), name, role, short teaser (1-2 lines), "View details" button.
Image URLs (reuse as needed for 8 cards):
1. https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?gallery,art
2. https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?exhibition,lights
3. https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?sculpture,museum
4. https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?museum,crowd
5. https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?art,installation
6. https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?theater,stage
Invent 8 plausible names/roles/teasers/bios/session times, e.g. mixed international artists: light installation artist, ambient composer, sculptor, performance artist, curator, projection artist, sound artist, art historian.
Artist modal (accessible): opens on "View details" click; shows name, role, image, longer bio (3-4 sentences), session time; close button (top-right X), closes on ESC key, closes on backdrop click, focus trapped/managed (focus moves into modal, returns to trigger on close), aria-modal="true", role="dialog", body scroll locked while open.

6) VENUE:
- Venue name: The Old Gallery, address: plac Komandorii 12, 00-101 Warsaw (or similar plausible address)
- Travel tips, accessibility notes (step-free access, lifts, accessible restrooms), parking note (limited on-site, recommend public transport), public transport note (metro line M2 + trams)
- Presented in glass info panels/cards
- Inline SVG map mock (roughly 400x300 viewBox): dark background, gallery block (rect with gold border + label "The Old Gallery"), a few street lines (strokes with street name labels like "Komandorii St", "Old Town Rd"), a metro/bus marker (circle with M / small icon + label "Metro M2"), an entrance marker (gold pin/arrow + label "Entrance"), and a dashed gold route line connecting metro marker → entrance. Pure inline SVG, no external assets.

7) TICKET TIERS — 3 premium cards side by side (stacked on mobile), middle one highlighted with "Recommended" badge and stronger gold border/glow:
- Night Pass — €29 — Entry after 19:00; Main exhibition access; Program access
- Curator Pass — €59 (RECOMMENDED badge) — Everything in Night Pass; Hidden collection tour; Reserved artist talk seating
- Patron Pass — €129 — Everything in Curator Pass; VIP lounge access; Signed event print; Priority entrance
Each card: tier name (serif), big price, feature list with small gold check/inline-SVG bullets, "Select tier" button with strong hover state.
Ticket modal checkout mock: shows selected tier name + price; attendee name input; email input; number of tickets (number input or select 1-6, min 1 max 6); total price computed live (price × qty); terms checkbox ("I understand this is a demo — no payment is processed"); "Confirm Reservation" button.
Validation: name required (min 2 chars), valid email regex, qty 1-6, terms must be checked — invalid fields get red-ish border + inline error messages; on success show success state inside modal (elegant confirmation with check icon, order-style summary) AND a toast notification. No real payment. Modal accessible like artist modal (ESC, backdrop, focus).

8) FAQ ACCORDION — at least 6 <details>-style items (build custom with buttons + max-height transition, aria-expanded):
- Is payment processed on this page? (No — demo, reservation only)
- Can I arrive late? (Yes, doors until 23:00 etc.)
- Are photos allowed? (Non-flash photography encouraged, some rooms restricted)
- Is the venue accessible? (Step-free, lifts, accessible restrooms)
- Can I change my ticket tier? (Yes up to 7 days before via support)
- How do I save the event to my calendar? (Use the Save to Calendar button — downloads .ics)
One item open at a time (opening one closes others). Smooth height animation.

9) NEWSLETTER:
- Headline, email input + submit button, inline validation (regex; error message below input), success clears form + shows toast "You're on the list". No backend — just UI mock.

10) FOOTER:
- ARTIFACT logo (same style as navbar)
- Event credits (curated by / produced by lines)
- Social-style text links (Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube — href="#" with hover gold)
- Copyright © 2026 ARTIFACT
- Small note: "Demo landing page — no real ticket purchase."

=== SPECIAL FEATURE — SAVE TO CALENDAR ===
"Save to Calendar" button (hero + mentioned in FAQ). On click, generate an .ics file client-side:
BEGIN:VCALENDAR / VERSION:2.0 / PRODID:-//ARTIFACT//Museum Night//EN / BEGIN:VEVENT with:
- UID (e.g. artifact-museum-night-2026@artifact.event)
- DTSTAMP
- DTSTART:20261018T190000
- DTEND:20261019T020000
- SUMMARY:ARTIFACT: Museum Night
- LOCATION:The Old Gallery, Warsaw
- DESCRIPTION:A cinematic after-hours museum event with exhibitions, performances, talks, and guided tours.
Use CRLF line endings (\r\n), create a Blob with type 'text/calendar', objectURL, temporary <a download="artifact-museum-night.ics">, click it, revokeObjectURL. Works from file:// with no backend. Also show a toast "Calendar file downloaded".

- Smooth scroll for all anchor links (CSS scroll-behavior:smooth + scroll-margin-top on sections for sticky navbar offset)
- Active nav state while scrolling
- Scroll reveal animations via IntersectionObserver (unobserve after reveal)
- Accessible modals (role=dialog, aria-modal, labelledby, ESC close, backdrop click close, focus management, body overflow hidden)
- FAQ accordion with aria-expanded
- Toast notification system (bottom-right/bottom-center stacked toasts, auto-dismiss ~4s, slide-in animation, close button)
- Ticket tier selection → modal
- Form validation with inline errors
- Mobile responsive layout (breakpoints ~1024/820/560px: hamburger nav, stacked cards, single-column timeline, fluid type via clamp())
- All buttons/links have visible :hover AND :focus-visible states (gold glow / outline)
- NO console errors — guard everything, use event delegation carefully
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion (disable reveal animations)

=== GENERAL QUALITY ===
- Consistent spacing rhythm, max-width ~1180px container, generous section padding (~110px vertical)
- Section headers: eyebrow (numbered, e.g. "02 · Program"), serif headline, short muted description, gold divider
- All content polished, production-ready copy, en-dashes in time ranges (19:00–02:00)
- Semantic HTML5 (header, nav, main, section, article, footer), alt attributes on images
- File works standalone; total ~1500-2000 lines is fine; make it genuinely beautiful and premium","path":"website_museum_zai-glm-5.3_01.html"}
